data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

data_tooling.name: Self-Hosting-Guide
data_tooling.summary: Self-Hosting Guide 是一份精心策划的资源集合，教你如何在自己的硬件或私有服务器上托管软件，涵盖云替代方案、大语言模型、家庭自动化、网络等主题。它的独特之处在于不仅列出工具，还通过结构化分类和实用建议传授自托管的设计原则——比如用 Docker 简化部署、用 WireGuard 保障安全连接。你可以把它当作路线图，从搭建 Home Assistant 智能家居开始，逐步替换 Google Drive、ChatGPT 等云服务，真正掌控自己的数据与隐私。
data_tooling.summary_en: Self-Hosting Guide is a curated collection of resources for locally hosting software, covering everything from cloud alternatives and LLMs to home automation and networking. It excels as a structured, opinionated list that teaches you not just tools but the principles of self-sufficiency and privacy. Use it as a roadmap to set up your own services with Docker, WireGuard, or Home Assistant, and gain control over your digital life.

data_tooling.name: teslamate
data_tooling.summary: TeslaMate 是一款自托管的数据记录器，专为特斯拉车主设计，自动收集并可视化驾驶数据。它基于 Elixir/Phoenix 构建后端，使用 Grafana 展示仪表盘，数据存储在 PostgreSQL 中。技术亮点在于通过 MQTT 实现实时遥测，并集成 OpenStreetMap 进行路线映射。你可以通过 Docker 或 Nix 轻松部署，还能与家庭自动化系统联动。适合希望深度分析行程、电池状态和能耗的车主，完全掌控自己的数据，无需依赖特斯拉云端。
data_tooling.summary_en: TeslaMate is a self-hosted data logger for Tesla vehicles that automatically collects and visualizes driving data. It uses Elixir/Phoenix for the backend and Grafana for dashboards, storing data in PostgreSQL. Technically, it leverages MQTT for real-time telemetry and integrates with OpenStreetMap for route mapping. You can deploy it via Docker or Nix, and extend it with home automation systems. Ideal for owners who want detailed analytics, trip history, and battery stats without relying on Tesla's cloud.

data_tooling.name: optimizerDuck
data_tooling.summary: optimizerDuck 是一款免费开源的 Windows 优化工具，旨在提升系统性能、保护隐私并简化调优流程。它将数十种常见的注册表和服务调整整合到简洁的界面中，让游戏玩家和高级用户无需手动编写脚本即可轻松精简 Windows。你可以直接从 GitHub 运行它，禁用遥测、停止不必要的服务或应用游戏优化。其模块化设计鼓励贡献者添加新的优化项，你也可以 Fork 项目来构建自定义预设，满足个人或企业部署需求。
data_tooling.summary_en: optimizerDuck is a free, open-source Windows optimization tool designed to boost performance, enhance privacy, and simplify system tweaking. It consolidates dozens of common registry and service adjustments into a clean interface, making it easy for gamers and power users to debloat Windows without manual scripting. You can run it directly from GitHub to disable telemetry, stop unnecessary services, or apply gaming-focused tweaks. Its modular design invites contributors to add new optimizations, and you can fork it to build custom presets for your own deployment needs.

ui_devex.name: iptv
ui_devex.summary: IPTV-org 是一个汇集全球公开 IPTV 频道的项目，解决了用户难以统一获取世界各地电视直播源的痛点。它通过 TypeScript 实现自动化管理，将数千个频道按国家、语言分类为标准化 M3U 播放列表，确保数据持续更新且易于解析。开发者可直接在 VLC、Kodi 等播放器中加载列表观看国际新闻与体育赛事，或基于其 API 构建定制化应用，例如创建专属频道导航或内容推荐系统，快速实验多源流媒体整合方案。
ui_devex.summary_en: IPTV-org is a comprehensive collection of publicly available IPTV channels that solves the challenge of accessing diverse global television streams without proprietary services. It organizes thousands of channels into structured M3U playlists using TypeScript for reliable parsing and categorization. You can integrate these playlists into media players like VLC or Kodi to instantly access international news, sports, and entertainment streams, or build custom applications using their well-documented API for personalized streaming solutions.
ui_devex.summary_zh: IPTV-org 是一个汇集全球公开 IPTV 频道的项目，解决了用户难以统一获取世界各地电视直播源的痛点。它通过 TypeScript 实现自动化管理，将数千个频道按国家、语言分类为标准化 M3U 播放列表，确保数据持续更新且易于解析。开发者可直接在 VLC、Kodi 等播放器中加载列表观看国际新闻与体育赛事，或基于其 API 构建定制化应用，例如创建专属频道导航或内容推荐系统，快速实验多源流媒体整合方案。

agents_workflows.name: Self-Hosting-Guide
agents_workflows.summary: Self-Hosting Guide 是一份精心策划的资源集合，教你如何在自己的硬件或私有服务器上托管软件，涵盖云替代方案、大语言模型、家庭自动化、网络等主题。它的独特之处在于不仅列出工具，还通过结构化分类和实用建议传授自托管的设计原则——比如用 Docker 简化部署、用 WireGuard 保障安全连接。你可以把它当作路线图，从搭建 Home Assistant 智能家居开始，逐步替换 Google Drive、ChatGPT 等云服务，真正掌控自己的数据与隐私。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Self-Hosting Guide is a curated collection of resources for locally hosting software, covering everything from cloud alternatives and LLMs to home automation and networking. It excels as a structured, opinionated list that teaches you not just tools but the principles of self-sufficiency and privacy. Use it as a roadmap to set up your own services with Docker, WireGuard, or Home Assistant, and gain control over your digital life.

agents_workflows.name: teslamate
agents_workflows.summary: TeslaMate 是一款自托管的数据记录器，专为特斯拉车主设计，自动收集并可视化驾驶数据。它基于 Elixir/Phoenix 构建后端，使用 Grafana 展示仪表盘，数据存储在 PostgreSQL 中。技术亮点在于通过 MQTT 实现实时遥测，并集成 OpenStreetMap 进行路线映射。你可以通过 Docker 或 Nix 轻松部署，还能与家庭自动化系统联动。适合希望深度分析行程、电池状态和能耗的车主，完全掌控自己的数据，无需依赖特斯拉云端。
agents_workflows.summary_en: TeslaMate is a self-hosted data logger for Tesla vehicles that automatically collects and visualizes driving data. It uses Elixir/Phoenix for the backend and Grafana for dashboards, storing data in PostgreSQL. Technically, it leverages MQTT for real-time telemetry and integrates with OpenStreetMap for route mapping. You can deploy it via Docker or Nix, and extend it with home automation systems. Ideal for owners who want detailed analytics, trip history, and battery stats without relying on Tesla's cloud.

deployment_serving.name: optimizerDuck
deployment_serving.summary: optimizerDuck 是一款免费开源的 Windows 优化工具，旨在提升系统性能、保护隐私并简化调优流程。它将数十种常见的注册表和服务调整整合到简洁的界面中，让游戏玩家和高级用户无需手动编写脚本即可轻松精简 Windows。你可以直接从 GitHub 运行它，禁用遥测、停止不必要的服务或应用游戏优化。其模块化设计鼓励贡献者添加新的优化项，你也可以 Fork 项目来构建自定义预设，满足个人或企业部署需求。
deployment_serving.summary_en: optimizerDuck is a free, open-source Windows optimization tool designed to boost performance, enhance privacy, and simplify system tweaking. It consolidates dozens of common registry and service adjustments into a clean interface, making it easy for gamers and power users to debloat Windows without manual scripting. You can run it directly from GitHub to disable telemetry, stop unnecessary services, or apply gaming-focused tweaks. Its modular design invites contributors to add new optimizations, and you can fork it to build custom presets for your own deployment needs.
